#Load Models - Bottom Up only

```{r}
#| label: load-models

setwd(
  "C:/Users/aay6/Desktop/Blepharisma_Warming/Bleph_warming_Oct_2023_FlowCytometer/All_data"
)

# Bacterial abundance: algae effect
fit_bact_algae <- readRDS(
  file.path(model_dir, "bact_abundance_algae.rds")
)

# Shannon diversity: algae effect
fit_shannon_algae <- readRDS(
  file.path(model_dir, "fit_shannon_algae.rds")
)

# Beta diversity: algae effect
fit_beta_algae <- readRDS(
  file.path(model_dir, "fit_beta_algae.rds")
)
```

# Calculate Reversibility

```{r}
#| label: reversibility

compute_reversibility_algae <- function(draws_df) {

  draws_df %>%
    group_by(.draw, Algae_Presence) %>%
    summarise(

      # Change during warming
      warming_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 7]),

      # Change during cooling
      cooling_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 21]),

      # Corresponding stable-treatment change during warming
      stable_warming =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 7]),

      # Corresponding stable-treatment change during cooling
      stable_cooling =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 21]),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      warming_corrected =
        warming_change - stable_warming,

      cooling_corrected =
        cooling_change - stable_cooling,

      reversibility =
        cooling_corrected - warming_corrected
    )
}
```

# Posterior Prediction Grid

```{r}
# Population-level prediction grid

newdata_algae <- expand.grid(
  Temperature = c("Stable", "Warming", "Recovery"),
  Day = c(7, 14, 21, 28),
  Jar = NA,
  Algae_Presence = c("No", "Yes")
)
```

### Bacterial Abundance

```{r}
# Bacterial abundance

draws_abundance_algae <- fit_bact_algae %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_algae,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_abundance_algae <- compute_reversibility_algae(
  draws_abundance_algae
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Abundance")
```

### Bacterial Diversity

```{r}
# Shannon diversity

draws_shannon_algae <- fit_shannon_algae %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_algae,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_shannon_algae <- compute_reversibility_algae(
  draws_shannon_algae
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Shannon")
```

### Bacterial Composition

```{r}
# Beta diversity

draws_beta_algae <- fit_beta_algae %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_algae,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_beta_algae <- compute_reversibility_algae(
  draws_beta_algae
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Beta")
```

## Combine Posterior Reversibility Distributions

```{r}
reversibility_algae_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance_algae,
  contrast_shannon_algae,
  contrast_beta_algae
)

# Standardize within each response for visualization only

reversibility_algae_df <- reversibility_algae_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    reversibility_std =
      reversibility / sd(reversibility, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## Spider Plot

```{r}
#| label: spider-setup

## Spider Plot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Axis setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

axis_min <- -3
axis_max <-  3

text_col <- "black"
grid_col <- "#EAF2FA"
inactive_col <- "#BDBDBD"

# Keep algae abundance as a visible but inactive fourth axis
metric_order <- c(
  "Abundance",
  "Shannon",
  "Beta"
)

axis_df <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    c(
      "Abundance",
      "Shannon",
      "Beta",
      "Algal abundance"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Abundance",
      "Shannon",
      "Beta",
      "Algal abundance"
    )
  ),

  metric_label = c(
    "Bacterial\nabundance",
    "Bacterial\ndiversity",
    "Bacterial\ncomposition",
    "Algal abundance\n(predictor)"
  ),

  angle = c(
    pi / 2,
    pi,
    0,
    3 * pi / 2
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize posterior distributions by algae treatment
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

radar_df <- reversibility_algae_df %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = metric_order
    ),

    Algae_Presence = factor(
      Algae_Presence,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Algae_Presence,
    metric
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    RI_median = median(reversibility_std, na.rm = TRUE),
    RI_low = quantile(reversibility_std, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    RI_high = quantile(reversibility_std, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    axis_df,
    by = "metric"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Algae_Presence,
    angle
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    r_plot = (RI_median - axis_min) / (axis_max - axis_min),
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


# Close each three-response polygon
radar_closed <- radar_df %>%
  group_by(Algae_Presence) %>%
  arrange(angle, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  bind_rows(slice(., 1)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Algae-treatment colors
algae_cols <- c(
  "No"  = "#4D4D4D",
  "Yes" = "#8FAF88"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider-plot grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

grid_levels <- seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.2)

# Grid now uses all four axes, creating the same diamond layout as Figure 1
grid_closed <- expand.grid(
  r_plot = grid_levels,
  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(r_plot, angle) %>%
  group_by(r_plot) %>%
  bind_rows(slice(., 1)) %>%
  ungroup()


axis_lines <- axis_df %>%
  tidyr::crossing(r_plot = c(0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


zero_grid <- expand.grid(
  r_plot = (0 - axis_min) / (axis_max - axis_min),
  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  bind_rows(slice(., 1))
```

```{r}
spider_fig3 <- ggplot() +

  geom_path(
    data = grid_closed,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = r_plot),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  # Active bacterial-response axes
  geom_line(
    data = axis_lines %>%
      filter(metric != "Algal abundance"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = metric),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  # Inactive predictor axis
  geom_line(
    data = axis_lines %>%
      filter(metric == "Algal abundance"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = inactive_col,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_path(
    data = zero_grid,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "11"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(
      x = 0.35,
      y = -0.10,
      label = "RI = 0"
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    angle = 45
  ) +

  geom_path(
    data = radar_closed,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      color = Algae_Presence,
      group = Algae_Presence
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    linejoin = "round"
  ) +

  # Active labels
  geom_text(
    data = axis_df %>%
      filter(metric != "Algal abundance"),
    aes(
      x = 1.23 * cos(angle),
      y = 1.23 * sin(angle),
      label = metric_label
    ),
    size = 10,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = text_col,
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  # Greyed-out predictor label
  geom_text(
    data = axis_df %>%
      filter(metric == "Algal abundance"),
    aes(
      x = 1.23 * cos(angle),
      y = 1.23 * sin(angle),
      label = metric_label
    ),
    size = 8,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = inactive_col,
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = algae_cols) +

  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    ylim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +

  theme_void(base_size = 18) +

  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(40, 40, 40, 40)
  )

spider_fig3
```


# Recovery Scenario Probabilities

```{r}
#| label: recovery-scenarios-algae

# Combine posterior draws across bacterial response variables
plot_cat_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance_algae,
  contrast_shannon_algae,
  contrast_beta_algae
)

# 5% tolerance used to distinguish recovery scenarios
tol <- 0.05

plot_cat_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  mutate(
    RI_category = case_when(

      # No recovery
      abs(cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "No recovery",

      # Complete reversibility
      abs(warming_corrected + cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Complete reversibility",

      # Overcompensation
      (warming_corrected - cooling_corrected) < 0 ~
        "Overcompensation",

      # Partial recovery
      sign(cooling_corrected) != sign(warming_corrected) &
        abs(cooling_corrected) < abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Partial recovery",

      # Compounding
      TRUE ~
        "Compounding"
    )
  )
```



### Calculate posterior scenario probabilities


```{r}
#| label: recovery-probabilities-algae

prob_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  count(
    metric,
    Algae_Presence,
    RI_category
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    Algae_Presence
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prob = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Set factor order
prob_df <- prob_df %>%
  mutate(
    Algae_Presence = factor(
      Algae_Presence,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    RI_category = factor(
      RI_category,
      levels = c(
        "Overcompensation",
        "Complete reversibility",
        "Partial recovery",
        "No recovery",
        "Compounding"
      )
    ),

    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "Abundance",
        "Shannon",
        "Beta"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(metric)
  )
```


### Calculate the overcompensation boundary


```{r}
#| label: recovery-boundary-algae

boundary_df <- prob_df %>%
  filter(
    RI_category == "Overcompensation"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    Algae_Presence
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    y_boundary = sum(prob),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bar_width <- 0.85

boundary_df <- boundary_df %>%
  mutate(
    x_num = as.numeric(metric),
    x_start = x_num - bar_width / 2,
    x_end = x_num + bar_width / 2
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: recovery-colors-algae

ri_levels <- c(
  "Compounding",
  "No recovery",
  "Partial recovery",
  "Complete reversibility",
  "Overcompensation"
)

ri_colors_cb <- c(
  "Compounding"            = "#0B4A8B",
  "No recovery"            = "#5E90E8",
  "Partial recovery"       = "#1AB5A8",
  "Complete reversibility" = "#D8C93C",
  "Overcompensation"       = "#9ACD00"
)
```


## Actual Panel B


```{r}
#| label: panel-b
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

panel_B_fig_3 <- ggplot(
  prob_df,
  aes(x = metric, y = prob, fill = RI_category)
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.85,
    color = NA,
    linewidth = 0,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    . ~ Algae_Presence,
    labeller = labeller(
      Algae_Presence = c(
        "No" = "Algae Absent",
        "Yes" = "Algae Present"
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ri_colors_cb
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.2, 0.02)),
    labels = c(
      "Abundance" = "Abundance",
      "Shannon"   = "Diversity",
      "Beta"      = "Composition"
    )
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = boundary_df,
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_boundary,
      yend = y_boundary
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#D8C93C",
    linewidth = 0.95
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probability",
    fill = "Recovery Scenario"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 24,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 25,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 22
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 28,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = unit(
      0.75,
      "lines"
    ),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(
      0.25,
      "lines"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 5
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    )
  )

panel_B_fig_3
```
